faq.q1: How do I place a custom clothing order?
faq.a1: Choose a marketplace design or create your own, then submit the order to a tailor.
faq.q2: What if the finished item doesn't fit?
faq.a2: One fit adjustment is free. Eligible unresolved issues may receive a refund.
faq.q3: How long does an order take?
faq.a3: Most orders take 5–14 business days. The estimate appears before confirmation.
faq.q4: Can I provide my own measurements?
faq.a4: Yes. Enter chest, waist, hips, length, and inseam in centimeters.
faq.a5: Yes. We deliver across Georgia; timing varies by location.
faq.q6: How do I become a tailor on Kere?
faq.a6: Choose the tailor option when signing in. Applications are reviewed within 2–3 business days.

aboutUs.heroDesc: Kere was founded in Tbilisi with a simple belief: clothing should fit the person wearing it, not the other way around. We built a marketplace that connects customers directly with Georgia's most talented independent tailors.
aboutUs.whyP1: Kere connects customers with independent Georgian tailors and gives local makers a place to present their work.
aboutUs.whyP2: At the same time, customers struggled to find custom clothing without knowing someone personally. Fast fashion filled the gap, but at a cost: ill-fitting clothes, poor quality, and mountains of waste.
aboutUs.whyP3: Kere bridges that gap. We give tailors a professional storefront and give customers access to truly bespoke clothing — at prices that are fair for everyone.
aboutUs.ctaDesc: Whether you're a customer or a tailor, there's a place for you on Kere.

helpCenter.heroDesc: Find answers to common questions about ordering, measurements, delivery, and more.
helpCenter.t1q1: How do I place a custom order?
helpCenter.t1a1: Choose a product, size, and color, then place the order from a customer account.
helpCenter.t1q2: Can I order without entering measurements?
helpCenter.t1a2: Yes. Without measurements, the tailor uses your selected standard size.
helpCenter.t1q3: How do I track my order?
helpCenter.t1a3: Open your dashboard to see: Pending → In Progress → Shipped → Delivered.
helpCenter.t2a1: Use a soft tape over light clothing or skin. Follow the illustrated Size Guide.
helpCenter.t2a2: Enter exact measurements instead of a standard size.
helpCenter.t2q3: I entered the wrong measurements — what now?
helpCenter.t2a3: Contact support immediately. Changes are possible only before production starts.
helpCenter.t3a1: Most orders take 7–14 business days; complex work may take 21. Shipping in Georgia takes another 1–3 days.
helpCenter.t3a2: Kere currently ships within Georgia only.
helpCenter.t3q3: My order says "Shipped" but I haven't received it.
helpCenter.t3a3: Wait three business days after the Shipped status before contacting support.
helpCenter.t4q1: Can I return a custom-made item?
helpCenter.t4a1: Made-to-order items cannot be returned for change of mind. Report incorrect or defective items within seven days.
helpCenter.t4q2: How do I request an alteration?
helpCenter.t4a2: Report fit issues within seven days for a free adjustment.
helpCenter.t4a3: Approved refunds return to the original payment method within 5–10 business days.
helpCenter.t5q1: What payment methods do you accept?
helpCenter.t5a1: We accept Visa and Mastercard debit or credit cards.
helpCenter.t5q2: Is it safe to enter my card details?
helpCenter.t5a2: Yes. A PCI-DSS compliant gateway processes payments; Kere does not store card numbers.
helpCenter.t5a3: Order summaries are in your dashboard. Contact support for a formal invoice.
helpCenter.t6q1: How do I reset my password?
helpCenter.t6a1: Use Forgot password. A reset link will be sent to your registered email.
helpCenter.t6q2: How do I contact a tailor?
helpCenter.t6a2: Message the tailor from the order details.
helpCenter.t6q3: How do I contact Kere support?
helpCenter.t6a3: Sign in and use Email Support. We reply within one business day.
helpCenter.stillDesc: Our support team is based in Tbilisi and responds within one business day.
helpCenter.signInNote: You need to be signed in to send a support email.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Kere collects, uses, and protects the personal information you provide when using our platform.
privacy.s1b1: Personal information you provide during registration: name, email address, phone number.
privacy.s1b2: Order and transaction data: garment specifications, measurements, order history.
privacy.s1b3: Communication data: messages exchanged between customers and tailors through the platform.
privacy.s1b4: Usage data: how you interact with the platform, device type, browser, IP address.
privacy.s2b1: To process and fulfill your orders and connect you with tailors.
privacy.s2b2: To send order confirmations, status updates, and service communications.
privacy.s2b3: To verify tailor identities and maintain platform quality.
privacy.s2b4: To improve the platform and resolve disputes.
privacy.s3b1: We share your name, contact details, and order specifications with the tailor assigned to your order.
privacy.s3b2: We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.s3b3: We may share data with service providers who help us operate the platform (hosting, email delivery) under confidentiality agreements.
privacy.s4b1: We retain your account data for as long as your account is active.
privacy.s4b2: Order records are retained for 5 years for legal and business purposes.
privacy.s4b3: You may request deletion of your account and associated data by contacting us.
privacy.s5b1: You have the right to access the personal data we hold about you.
privacy.s5b2: You have the right to correct inaccurate data or request its deletion.
privacy.s5b3: You may withdraw consent for marketing communications at any time.
privacy.s6b1: We use industry-standard security measures to protect your data.
privacy.s6b2: Passwords are stored in hashed form and never in plaintext.
privacy.s6b3: Session tokens are stored securely and expire on logout.
privacy.s7b1: We use essential cookies for session management and security.
privacy.s7b2: We do not use advertising cookies and never sell your data.
privacy.s7b3: With your consent, we use Microsoft Clarity to understand how visitors use Kere — through heatmaps and anonymised session replays — so we can improve the site.
privacy.s7b4: Clarity masks the text you enter into forms.
privacy.s7b5: You can decline analytics from the consent banner at any time; declining keeps only the essential cookies.
privacy.s8b1: For privacy-related enquiries, contact us at: kereforyou@gmail.com
privacy.s8b2: Kere — Custom Clothing Marketplace, Tbilisi, Georgia.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.introBanner: Because all garments on Kere are made to order specifically for you, we follow a custom-order refund policy rather than a standard return policy.
refund.e1: The finished garment significantly differs from the agreed specifications.
refund.e2: The tailor cancels the order after payment is received.
refund.e3: The order is not delivered within 30 days of the confirmed delivery date.
refund.e4: A material defect is reported within 7 days of delivery.
refund.n1: Dissatisfaction due to inaccurate measurements provided by the customer.
refund.n2: Minor variation in fabric shade (natural variation in handmade textiles).
refund.n3: Change of mind after production has begun.
refund.n4: Orders where the customer has not responded to the tailor's fit-check messages within 7 days.
refund.cancellationText: You may cancel an order without charge within 24 hours of placement, provided the tailor has not yet begun work. After production starts, a partial cancellation fee may apply.
refund.cancellationDesc: You may cancel an order without charge within 24 hours of placement, provided the tailor has not yet begun work. After production starts, a partial cancellation fee may apply.
refund.p1: Contact us within 7 days of delivery at kereforyou@gmail.com with your order number and photos of the issue.
refund.p2: We will review your case within 3 business days.
refund.p3: If approved, refunds are processed within 5–10 business days to your original payment method.
refund.p4: In some cases, we may offer a free alteration instead of a refund.
refund.step1Desc: Email us at kereforyou@gmail.com within 7 days of receiving your order. Include your order number, a description of the issue, and photographs.
refund.step2Desc: Our team reviews your request within 3 business days. We may ask additional questions or request additional photos.
refund.step3Desc: We will offer one of the following: alteration at no extra cost, partial refund, or full refund depending on the nature of the issue.
refund.step4Desc: Approved refunds are processed within 5–10 business days to your original payment method.
refund.ctaText: If you have questions about your order or a refund, our support team is here.
refund.ctaDesc: Contact our support team within 7 days of delivery. We are based in Tbilisi and respond within one business day.

measurementGuide.title: Measurement Guide
measurementGuide.chestTip: Wear a light shirt or no shirt for the most accurate result.
measurementGuide.chestStep1: Stand straight with arms relaxed at your sides.
measurementGuide.chestStep2: Wrap the measuring tape around the fullest part of your chest — usually at nipple level.
measurementGuide.chestStep3: Keep the tape horizontal and parallel to the floor.
measurementGuide.chestStep4: Breathe normally — do not suck in or expand your chest.
measurementGuide.chestStep5: Read the tape where it meets itself. That number in cm is your chest measurement.
measurementGuide.waistTip: Measure over bare skin or thin clothing for the best fit.
measurementGuide.waistStep2: Locate your natural waist — the narrowest point of your torso, just above the belly button.
measurementGuide.waistStep3: Wrap the tape around this point, keeping it horizontal.
measurementGuide.waistStep4: The tape should be snug but not tight — you should be able to slide one finger under it.
measurementGuide.waistStep5: Read the measurement where the tape overlaps.
measurementGuide.hipsTip: Stand with feet together for the widest hip reading.
measurementGuide.hipsStep2: Find the widest point of your hips and buttocks — usually about 20 cm below your natural waist.
measurementGuide.hipsStep3: Wrap the tape around this widest point, keeping it level all the way around.
measurementGuide.hipsStep4: Make sure the tape is not twisted and lies flat against your body.
measurementGuide.lengthTip: Have a friend help for the most accurate reading.
measurementGuide.lengthStep2: For tops: start at the highest point of your shoulder (where the seam would sit).
measurementGuide.lengthStep3: For bottoms: start at your natural waist.
measurementGuide.lengthStep4: Run the tape straight down to where you want the garment to end.
measurementGuide.lengthStep5: Keep the tape straight — do not follow the curve of the body.
measurementGuide.chartNote: All measurements in cm. If you are between sizes, choose the larger one and let your tailor adjust.
measurementGuide.chartFootnote: Length refers to top/shirt length from shoulder seam. For trousers, provide inseam separately.
